summary: Frontend-only UX audit of Modul Logistik (sortable table, clickable rows, deep-links, empty state, mobile cards, role gating). All 7 requested test scenarios PASSED. Verified via Playwright on the public URL for roles admin@, warehouse@, sales@, driver@ (KSC entity). Sorting (number/eta/status) correct in both directions with aria-sort updating; late-ETA highlight only on active statuses; row click + Enter open the detail modal; open-order deep-link goes to Pesanan (view=orders) with SO selected and does NOT open the modal; Perjalanan Pesanan 'Buka di Logistik' round-trips back to Logistik with the correct delivery modal open; empty-state + 'Tampilkan semua' works; mobile driver cards + wrapped driver panel with no horizontal overflow; GPS map regression in LG-00007 OK. Only 2 cosmetic/minor observations, no blocking defects.

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close the detail modal (modal still present after keypress); only the X button closes it. Rows are keyboard-openable (Enter/Space) so keyboard users cannot dismiss with Esc.

issues: ETA field uses the browser-native date input (native calendar picker + dd/mm/yyyy chrome) instead of the app's own date component — inconsistent with the rest of the UI
Foto muat / POD thumbnails for LG-00002/00004 render as solid black boxes (seeded placeholder images) — visually reads as broken image

action_items: OPTIONAL: add Escape-to-close (and focus trap / focus return to the triggering row) on logistics-detail-modal
OPTIONAL: replace native date input for ETA in the delivery detail modal with the app's date component

PRE-EXISTING (not from this session): restricted roles (driver) get console 403s on GET /api/uoms and GET /api/document-templates during app bootstrap — gate these bootstrap fetches by permission to remove console noise
critical_code_review_comments: DeliveryTable sort comparator uses `String(d[sort.key] ?? "")` for the generic case; sorting by 'order_number' will sort by the raw string and place '—'/empty first — acceptable today but note numeric-suffix strings (SO-0010 vs SO-0009) sort lexicographically, which is fine for zero-padded numbers only.

isLate() compares ISO date strings against local `new Date().toISOString()` (UTC). For Asia/Jakarta (UTC+7) a delivery due today can be flagged/unflagged incorrectly for a 7-hour window around midnight. Consider computing 'today' in the business timezone.

LogisticsView focusDelivery effect resets `status` to "" and sets openId, but does not reset the free-text search `q`; a deep-linked delivery filtered out by an active search will open the modal while the table appears unrelated (cosmetic).
seed_data_creation: None. No deliveries created, transitioned, or deleted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend is a prebuilt static bundle (no hot reload); rebuild via bash /app/scripts/rebuild_frontend.sh if src must change. Navigation is data-testid nav-* (NOT hash routing). Login then click scope-pick-ent_ksc (banner may be absent if entity already stored in the session). Verified evidence this run: number sort asc ['KSC/LG-00002','00004','00005','00006','00007'] and desc; ETA asc ['2026-09-01','09-04','09-05','09-06','9999(—)'] with '—' last, desc reverses and puts '—' first; status asc Disiapkan→Dalam perjalanan→Terkirim→Selesai→Selesai; aria-sort flips ascending/descending. LG-00005 shows red 'terlambat'; LG-00004 (Selesai, eta 2026-09-05) and LG-00002 do not. logistics-open-order-* → /?view=orders with SO-0001 selected and modal count 0; order-pane-journey → journey-logistics with 4 journey-logistics-open-* buttons; clicking one returned to logistics-view with modal header 'KSC/LG-00004'. logistics-detail-open-order also navigated to orders and closed the modal. Filter logistics-filter-failed → logistics-empty ('Belum ada pengiriman berstatus "Gagal kirim"') + logistics-clear-filter restores the table. Role gating: warehouse open-order=0/create=1/readonly=0/detail-link=0; sales open-order=5/create=0/readonly=1/detail-link=1; driver (390x844) cards visible, table hidden, 5 cards, card click opens modal, detail-open-order=0, driver-today-panel scrollWidth==clientWidth (no overflow).
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional defect reproduced. The only two findings are cosmetic (missing Esc-to-close handler in DeliveryDetailModal, and a native date input used for ETA).
